mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user ( user_id, registration_id, account_number, phone_number, real_name, nickname, phone_tail, identity_status, status, version, created_at, updated_at, id_card, id_card_hash ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{registrationId}, #{accountNumber}, #{phoneNumber}, #{realName}, #{nickname}, #{phoneTail}, #{identityStatus}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{idCard}, #{idCardHash} )
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.registration_id, u.account_number, u.phone_number, u.real_name, u.nickname, u.phone_tail, u.identity_status, u.status, u.version, u.created_at, u.updated_at, u.disabled_by, u.disabled_reason, c.login_lock_until, u.id_card, u.id_card_hash FROM app_user u LEFT JOIN credential c ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT u.user_id, u.registration_id, u.account_number, u.phone_number, u.real_name, u.nickname, u.phone_tail, u.identity_status, u.status, u.version, u.created_at, u.updated_at, u.disabled_by, u.disabled_reason, c.login_lock_until, u.id_card, u.id_card_hash FROM app_user u LEFT JOIN credential c ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.account_number = #{accountNumber}

SELECT u.user_id, u.registration_id, u.account_number, u.phone_number, u.real_name, u.nickname, u.phone_tail, u.identity_status, u.status, u.version, u.created_at, u.updated_at, u.disabled_by, u.disabled_reason, c.login_lock_until, u.id_card, u.id_card_hash FROM app_user u LEFT JOIN credential c ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.phone_number = #{phoneNumber}

SELECT u.user_id, u.registration_id, u.account_number, u.phone_number, u.real_name, u.nickname, u.phone_tail, u.identity_status, u.status, u.version, u.created_at, u.updated_at, u.disabled_by, u.disabled_reason, c.login_lock_until, u.id_card, u.id_card_hash FROM app_user u LEFT JOIN credential c ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.registration_id = #{registrationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET account_number = #{accountNumber}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, real_name = #{realName}, nickname = #{nickname}, phone_tail = #{phoneTail}, identity_status = #{identityStatus}, status = #{status}, disabled_by = #{disabledBy}, disabled_reason = #{disabledReason}, id_card = #{idCard}, id_card_hash = #{idCardHash}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND version = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM app_user WHERE phone_number = #{phoneNumber}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM app_user WHERE id_card_hash = #{idCardHash} AND user_id != #{excludeUserId}
